tags.label: Chladni figures and Faraday-wave quasicrystals
tags.description: Sand settles on the nodal lines of a vibrating plate (E. F. F. Chladni, 1787). The lattice and quasicrystal plates are sums of plane waves at equal angles, the shape of Faraday-wave superlattices. Written for the Teamcrafter residency, 2026-10-06.
